limitations.note: The rewrite stopped the counter from advancing on invalid cycles, but it also removed the registered reset behavior of ready_a, allowed input capture on the first clock after reset, and changed valid_b from a registered count decode to a sixth-transfer pulse.

The testbench expected ready_a to be high even during reset and valid_b to stay low during a stall after five accepted bits, so it endorsed the rewrite instead of detecting its differences from the original timing.

limitations.quote: use the same acceptance-and-completion condition for that pulse and the data write
limitations.note: The agent applied this advice from a different packer to valid_b, but this task's reference preserves the registered count decode and changes only the counter's hold condition.

limitations.quote: rm -f style commands are not permitted.
limitations.note: The rejected cleanup command forced the verification invocation to be resubmitted with a different temporary-directory setup, after an earlier Git failure had already forced the tool-availability check to be retried.
